name: Aareon
positioning: The European ERP of social and institutional housing — where the tenant file, the rent and the works order live together.
description: Aareon provides enterprise property management software for social landlords, institutional owners and large managers across Europe, with a French organisation serving bailleurs sociaux: tenant and lease management, rent and charge accounting, allocation processes, maintenance and tenant self-service portals.
real_estate_use: French social housing operates under rules no commercial system covers: regulated rents, the allocation commission, the surface and resource ceilings, the supplément de loyer. Aareon's French deployments encode those processes, which is why the sector runs on specialised ERPs rather than on general property management platforms.
features: Tenant, lease and allocation management for regulated housing
Rent and charge accounting with regulatory rules
Tenant self-service portal and digital services

use_cases.job: Run regulated allocation and rent processes for a social housing portfolio
Hold asset, lease and works data for a large institutional patrimony in one ERP
